- **Key Provision:** The bank maintains a conservative liquidity risk appetite to withstand severe idiosyncratic and market-wide stress scenarios. The consolidated Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) must remain above 115% at all times (regulatory minimum is 100%), with an internal early warning trigger at 120%. Per the Risk Appetite Statement [DOC-RAS-001], quantitative metrics must be maintained within the specified tolerance bands. Any approach toward early warning thresholds necessitates immediate ALCO or Risk Committee escalation.
